name: Full Body Express
description: Two concise sessions combine a squat or leg press, a hinge, a press and a pull.
schedule: Leave at least a day between the two sessions. Add time for setup and warm-ups.
progression: Start with a manually calibrated load and leave the prescribed spare reps. Add reps within the range first. Review a small load increase only after completing all upper-range sets with headroom; never force an increase. The offline history engine supplies optional personal targets after comparable actual sessions.
notes: Working sets only; warm-ups are separate. Adjust the local copy to equipment and recovery. If a movement causes pain, stop and choose an appropriate alternative rather than forcing the prescription.
